OSD-1010.title: Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG modulates epithelial responses to space-relevant heavy-ion irradiation in a human gut-on-chip
OSD-1010.evidence_limitation: In-vitro gut-on-chip model; supports mechanism context only. Does not validate personal risk prediction, clinical thresholds, or probiotic intervention.

OSD-684.title: Human skeletal muscle tissue chip autonomous payload reveals changes in fiber type and metabolic gene expression due to spaceflight
OSD-684.evidence_limitation: Human myobundle tissue-chip; not a wearable feed, muscle strength measurement, bone-density measurement, or clinical predictor.

OSD-816.title: The ex vivo human translaminar autonomous system to study spaceflight associated neuro-ocular syndrome pathogenesis
OSD-816.evidence_limitation: Ex vivo human ocular model; no consumer wearable ICP:IOP inference, diagnosis, or invented pressure threshold.

OSD-939.title: Deficits in Sustained Attention and Changes in Dopaminergic Protein Levels following Exposure to Proton Radiation
OSD-939.assay: Rodent psychomotor vigilance task (rPVT) & dopaminergic protein assay
OSD-939.evidence_limitation: Animal, strain-specific evidence; motivates cautious vigilance monitoring hypothesis only. Never establishes human dose-response or fitness-for-duty.

BRSMPT-ARES-C1.title: BRSMPT Campaign 1 Ares Analog Behavioral & Cognitive Task Battery (Subjects 1, 2, 3)
BRSMPT-ARES-C1.assay: Simple Reaction Time, Running Memory, Matching to Sample, mRTC, Obsv_All
BRSMPT-ARES-C1.evidence_limitation: Analog campaign cognitive task battery; vigilance change alone never triggers RED and never diagnoses psychiatric conditions.
